nodes.klein: to strike, beat; whence ‘to thrust, impel, move’. he struck, beat, thrust, impelled (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Jud. 13:25 with first suff. לְפַעֲמוֹ, ‘to impel him’). was disturbed, was troubled, was moved. he beat, perturbed. was agitated, was disturbed, was troubled, was moved (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Dan. 2:1 in the form וַתִּתְפָּעֶם). he caused (the heart) to beat, excited. was excited.
